changed_approach.decision: Accept the proposed capability-gated method split. This differs materially from v6: constructor eligibility stays v1 LifecycleAuthority; P4 eligibility is checked only at the new authorize_capture_set doorway against that already-bound object.
changed_approach.verifier: HistoricalStudyVerifier(authority) accepts any valid isinstance(authority, LifecycleAuthority), identity-pins it, and retains bind/capture unchanged. authorize_capture_set first requires exact HistoricalStudyVerifier, operational authority identical to its constructor pin, isinstance(pinned, CapturedAuthorizationAuthority), then private broker attestation of the exact object plus exact registered final class and immutable class-owned dispatch capsule. It invokes only that capsule. A v1 authority refuses before all effects; no authority/dependency argument, upgrade, wrapper, duck, subclass, copy, state rebuild, instance override, or post-construction replacement is a P4 route.
changed_approach.driver: HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver preserves its exact verifier constructor/pin and legacy capture delegation. Its new authorize_capture_set invokes HistoricalStudyVerifier's checked class-bound method on that one verifier; it accepts no authority, factory, fixture, or dependency and owns no writer/state/lock/ledger/admission/receipt/session.
changed_approach.composition: Only the external broker or private fixed _development_p4_broker creates/registers an exact P4 capability. _development_broker stays v1-only with its existing signature. Hostile closed fixture facts never select dependencies/trust roots. The P4 capability stays nonconstructible, exact-attested, fixed-graph, one-ledger/one-lock, and deployment_eligible=false.
changed_approach.no_dual_authority: The P4 authority can only be the object originally passed to and pinned by the verifier. authorize_capture_set has no authority parameter; bind still accepts only legacy artifacts; a legacy verifier cannot be upgraded by assignment or a second facade.

substitution_and_toctou_fixes: Verifier pins authority identity; driver pins verifier identity. P4 checks both at invocation, and the authority repeats issuance/dependency/dispatch checks before preparation and under its one transition lock before commit.

isinstance(CapturedAuthorizationAuthority) is only the first filter. Private registration of exact object and final class plus captured class dispatch rejects ABC virtual registration, foreign/subclass, wrapper, duck, alias to another object, copy, pickle, and reconstructed state.
Legacy capture/open/bind/member/consume/release stays on the same ledger lock as P4. No facade has an unlocked not-P4 check; a P4 reservation/commit races legacy only through that one transition.

Prepared bytes remain inaccessible/non-authoritative. The same immutable commit consumes admission before publishing the complete batch/session-start; uncertain outcome resolves same identity and never remints.
required_successor_tests: Positive compatibility: _development_broker remains accepted; existing bind/capture and driver.capture behavior, including test_driver_delegates_bound_verifier_capture, stays green.

V1 negative: a valid v1-only authority verifier/driver refuses authorize_capture_set before capture receipt, P4 record/ledger, session event, member/provider, or admission effects; ordinary direct v1 capture remains positive.
P4 positive: only the private P4 factory capability succeeds through direct verifier and driver class-bound methods using its one held authority/ledger.

Substitution: authority/verifier swap, late authority injection, virtual/foreign/private-final subclass, duck/wrapper, instance/class rebinding, copy/pickle/reduce/state/dict/slots reconstruction all refuse before P4 effects; preserve the legacy driver class-method-capture test.

TOCTOU: swap verifier authority after validation, between verifier dispatch and authority lock, and mutate one dependency/attestation/dispatch capsule before prepare, during reservation, and before commit. Each refuses or leaves no effect. ADR-0126 coordinated multi-private rewrites remain deferred.
Retain P4V5-R01..R08 and P4V6-R09..R13, adding direct verifier/driver compatibility cases to the facade schedules.
